notes.title: V 1.0.0.0 Update Release Note And FREE DLC Release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! The 1.0 version of Endless Winter is finally on line!

In the new version, we have added a new Challenge Mode and provided the free DLC Map Editor.

+Challenge Mode
In the challenge mode, you need to challenge a large map with multiple checkpoints. Along the way, the fox store has prepared various supplies for you. You can purchase them by collecting the badge of snow fox. After passing the map, you can upload your time record to see the global ranking list.

+DLC:Map Editor
In the map editor, you can create your own challenge mode map and share it with other players through steam workshop. And you can download other player's challenge mode map for play.

Have a good time!

[/olist]

notes.title: V 0.8.4.0 Update Release Note
notes.notes:
Hello, we are Darksun Studio. It’s our first update.
In this update, we mainly fixed some obvious bugs and problems, and did some performance optimization.
The details are as follows:
1.	Optimized the level part, reduced the difficulty. Some part of the place that should not be reached cannot be reached now.
2.	Optimized controls:
a)	Added [Space Bar] as a brake key. You can stop the car on the normal road by pressing [Space Bar]. And the car can turn in situ while holding down the brake.
b)	In the meantime, observing by dragging the mouse is only effective when the brake key is pressed.
c)	Increased the turning speed on snow slightly. It’s easier to control now.
3.	Added keyboard control. Players can use [W] or [Up Arrow] to go ahead, [A]/[D] or [Left Arrow]/[Right Arrow] to turn. It doesn’t open by default. Players need to change it on settings page. (Keyboard control is more difficult, not recommended.) 
4.	Added headlight, opened by default. It can be turned on/off by [Left Ctrl].
5.	Optimized the road texture.
6.	Now the robots will ridicule you by actions.
7.	Added lower-level resolution support and optimized anti-aliasing effects. Enhanced part of the game performance. If you still encounter lagging, it is recommended to turn off the anti-aliasing.
8.	Fixed some bugs.

We will bring you a more interesting multiplayer mode, as well as some new achievements later.
We are very grateful to the feedbacks and helps from you. Thank you so much!
Wish you have a happy game time!
